I appreciate the creative question, but I'm Maple, Northshore Credit Union's virtual assistant! My expertise is in helping members with mortgages, lines of credit, GICs, and everyday banking—not zombie epidemiology. 😊

That said, if you're thinking about **emergency preparedness and financial planning**, I can actually help with that! Here's what makes sense:

**Real emergency planning involves:**
- Building an emergency fund (typically 3-6 months of expenses)
- Reviewing your insurance coverage
- Ensuring your will and financial documents are in order
- Having accessible accounts for quick access to funds

If a major crisis (natural disaster, job loss, illness) disrupts your finances, having a solid banking relationship and emergency plan makes a real difference.

**Is there anything I can help you with regarding:**
- Setting up a savings account for emergencies?
- Discussing lines of credit as backup funds?
- Planning your financial security?

Feel free to ask about actual banking needs, or if you'd like to chat with one of our advisors about emergency financial planning, I'm happy to help you book an appointment!

value.bank_note: Usable by a bank through an API account. Credit and financial recommendations need review by a qualified person, and customers must be told they are talking to AI. Anthropic does not train on API data.

fields.name: Training data disclosure
fields.value: Partial, by category only: public internet data up to February 2025, non-public third-party data, data from labelling services and contractors, opted-in user data, and internally generated data.

fields.name: Permitted / prohibited uses
fields.value: Governed by the Usage Policy. Finance and credit are high-risk uses: a qualified person must review AI recommendations, people must be told AI was used, and customer chatbots must say they are AI.

fields.name: Official documentation
fields.value: Yes: system card (October 2025) and launch post (October 15, 2025)

fields.name: Disclosed risks
fields.value: Evaluation awareness (about 9% of audit transcripts) reduces trust in results; more reward hacking than Sonnet 4.5; occasionally gave high-level information on sensitive scientific topics; slight self-favouring bias; no human uplift trials.

fields.name: Audit contact
fields.value: Harmful content: claude.com/form/anthropic-content-reporting. Model safety issues: Anthropic safety team email (on the support page). Security: Responsible Disclosure Policy.
